assessment: This important study presents an exciting new method for separating organelles in an unbiased way and applies this method to the separation of distinct subpopulations of insulin vesicles. Solid evidence is presented that this method is capable of separating distinct subpopulations of insulin vesicles, but the identification of these subpopulations is incomplete and the biological significance of the proposed changes in vesicle populations remains unclear. This work will be of interest to cell biologists studying a variety of organelles.
